hero.headlineLiteral: We could not complete this operation right now
hero.defaultDescriptionLiteral: A temporary instability occurred while processing your request. Our engineering team has already received an automatic incident report.
hero.guidanceHintLiteral: You may return to the home page and try again in a few moments. If the issue persists, please share the tracking reference below.

errors.CONFIRMATION_FAULT: An internal error occurred while validating or activating your subscription confirmation. No personal data was lost; you may request a new link or try again.
errors.GATEWAY_FAULT: One of our communication gateways experienced a brief interruption while handling your request.
errors.UNKNOWN_FAULT: An unexpected interruption occurred while processing your request on this route.
